message.content:
**Traffic Laws in Texas – A Quick Reference Guide** | Topic | Key Points | Where to Find More Info | |-------|------------|------------------------| | **Speed Limits** | • Posted limits are the law.
• 55 mph on rural interstates, 65 mph on urban interstates, 45 mph on most highways, 35 mph on city streets.
• “No speed limit” zones exist in some rural areas. | Texas Department of Transportation (TxDOT) – Speed Limit Regulations | | **Seat‑belt & Child Safety** | • All drivers and passengers must wear seat belts.
• Children under 8 must be in a child safety seat or booster.
• The “no seat‑belt” law applies to all vehicles. | Texas Transportation Code §545.001 | | **Cell‑Phone Use** | • Hand‑held phone use while driving is illegal.
• Hands‑free devices are allowed.
• Texting while driving is prohibited. | Texas Transportation Code §545.021 | | **Driving Under Influence (DUI)** | • Blood Alcohol Concentration (BAC) of 0.08% or higher is illegal.
• Zero‑tolerance for drivers under 21.
• Penalties include fines, license suspension, and possible jail time. | Texas Transportation Code §545.021 | | **Right‑of‑Way** | • At uncontrolled intersections, the vehicle on the right has the right of way.
• Pedestrians have priority at crosswalks.
• Yield to emergency vehicles with lights/alarms. | Texas Transportation Code §545.021 | | **School Bus Rules** | • Stop for a school bus with flashing red lights and extended stop sign.
• Vehicles must stop on both sides of the road. | Texas Transportation Code §545.021 | | **Lane‑Changing & Overtaking** | • Use turn signals.
• Do not cut off other drivers.
• Overtaking on the right is prohibited unless the lane is marked for passing. | Texas Transportation Code §545.021 | | **Parking Regulations** | • No parking in front of driveways, fire hydrants, or on sidewalks.
• Parking in a handicap space requires a valid permit. | Texas Transportation Code §545.021 | | **Traffic Signals & Signs** | • Red = stop, green = go, yellow = prepare to stop.
• Stop signs, yield signs, and traffic lights must be obeyed. | Texas Transportation Code §545.021 | | **Vehicle Registration & Inspection** | • All vehicles must be registered and display a valid license plate.
• Most vehicles require an annual safety inspection. | Texas Department of Motor Vehicles (TxDMV) | | **Insurance Requirements** | • Minimum liability coverage: $30,000 for bodily injury per person, $60,000 for total bodily injury, $25,000 for property damage. | TxDMV – Insurance Requirements | | **Special Situations** | • **Towing**: Must use a tow bar or chain; cannot tow a vehicle that is not in motion.
• **Motorcycles**: Must wear a helmet; helmets must meet DOT standards. | TxDMV – Motorcycles & Towing | --- ### How to Stay Updated 1. **Texas Transportation Code** – The official source for all traffic laws. 2. **TxDOT Website** – Offers updates on road conditions, speed limits, and construction. 3. **TxDMV** – Provides information on registration, insurance, and driver licensing. 4. **Local County Courts** – For recent changes or local ordinances that may supplement state law. --- ### Quick Tips for Safe Driving in Texas - **Always keep your seat belt fastened** – it’s a legal requirement and saves lives. - **Avoid distractions** – especially cell‑phone use; use hands‑free if you must talk. - **Observe speed limits** – they’re posted for a reason; exceeding them can lead to hefty fines. - **Respect school buses and pedestrians** – they have priority. - **Keep your vehicle in good condition** – regular inspections help avoid accidents and fines. If you need more detailed information on a specific topic (e.g., DUI penalties, insurance coverage, or how to register a vehicle), let me know!
